contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A mostly complete, struck or hammered, Copper alloy, Roman nummi or AE4 coin. House of Constantine commemorative issue. Obverse: Diadem, draped bust right. Inscription: Const[]. Reverse: Two soldiers standing either side of two standards. Inscription: [GLORIA EXCERC]ITVS. Mint mark: Missing. Die axis: 12 o'clock. The coin is in slightly worn or very fine condition but two edges of this coin are broken away by corrosion and by 'plough' damage. Otherwise the coin has an attractive dark green patina but some areas of light green matt corrosion around some of the edges and high spots. This coin is likely to date from 330-335AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2011, page 62 no. 599A and…
